data.name: Kalsom
data.gender_notes: Kalsom is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Kalsom is an Arabic name traditionally meaning 'healthy', 'chubby-cheeked', or 'rosy-faced'. It was famously borne by Fatimah Kalsom, a daughter of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ. The name Kalsom carries the meaning “Full of Flesh, Healthy, Rosy-Cheeked” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Arabic. Parents who choose Kalsom usually hope their child will grow to embody full of flesh, healthy, rosy-cheeked and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes inner beauty, health, and purity — a name of blessed feminine charm.
data.etymology: Kalsom belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Full of Flesh, Healthy, Rosy-Cheeked.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kalsom total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: كلثوم
in_arabic.meaning: الاسم المختار من اللغة العربيّة، يعنى بالخير والبركة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم علم عربي يأتي من اللفظ (ك-ل-ث-وْم) والذي يرمز إلى الخير والبركة، وهو إحدى أسماء الصالحين في الإسلام. وفقًا للمصادر التاريخية، تم وصف كلثوم بأنه لقب منحته السيدة عائشة لولدها، حيث تعني الخير والبركة. في الأصل، كان الاسم يُطلق على شخص يملك الخير والبركة، ويتسم بمظاهر الحنان والرحمة. في الإسلام، يرتبط الاسم بالعديد من الشخصيات التاريخية، بما في ذلك الصحابي الجليل زيد بن ثابت، الذي كان معروفًا بأسماء كثيرة، بينها كلثوم. من خلال التأثير الإسلامي، أصبح الاسم منتشرًا في العديد من المجتمعات الإسلامية، مما أدى إلى ظهور أسماء مشتقة منه، مثل كلثومية. في الحضارة الإسلامية، كان الاسم يُستخدم في العديد من السياقات، بما في ذلك التأليف والادب. تم تسجيل الاسم في العديد من الكتب والقصص والتراث الإسلامي، مما يعكس حياته الثقافية والدينية.

In Islamic tradition, the name Kalsom is associated with the virtues of kindness, generosity, and mercy. The name is mentioned in the Quran and is a name of great importance in Islamic culture. Kalsom is also a name of great historical significance, having been borne by several notable figures throughout Islamic history. The name has been popularized in various cultures and languages, including Turkish and Urdu, and is a popular choice for parents seeking a name that conveys happiness and blessings.

Roominess and pleasantness are integral concepts in Islamic culture, with the term 'rijal malih' literally meaning 'men of broad chests,' signifying strength and generosity. The name Kalsom, meaning 'healthy' and implying well-being and chubbiness, represents these endearing Middle Eastern ideals of fullness and vitality.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic belief, the human body is a precious gift from Allah, entrusted to us as a vehicle for our spiritual journey in this life. The name Kalsom can thus be seen as a reminder of the importance of taking good care of our physical health, which reflects the state of our soul and the pleasure we give to Allah. Fatimah Kalsom, being a prophet's daughter, set a high standard in model behavior. By naming a child Kalsom, parents can inspire their child to preserve good health as a means to maintain both spiritual growth and material prosperity in their lives.
